7.9.3.1 BSW Level
The Operating System provides a basic mechanism for synchronizing the starts of the operating systems on the master and slave cores. The Scheduler Manager provides basic mechanisms for communication of BSW modules across partition boundaries. One BSW Mode Manager per core is responsible for starting and stopping the RTE. Refer to the Guide to Mode Management [23] for a more complete description of the solution approaches and for a discussion of the considerations in choosing between them.
